tools.name: identify_perfume
tools.description: Identify a perfume from a photo of its bottle. Returns the most likely perfumes, best first, with a similarity score. Give a public https image_url or image_base64 (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

tools.name: search_perfumes
tools.description: Search perfumes by name or house, in Arabic or English (Arabic spelling variants included).

tools.name: get_perfume
tools.description: The full record of one perfume: names in Arabic/English/French, house, top/heart/base notes, accords, perfumers, year, rating, performance (longevity, sillage, season, climate), descriptions and images.

tools.name: find_similar_perfumes
tools.description: Perfumes that smell alike, by shared notes and accords.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Where a perfume is sold and for how much, by country (SA, EG, AE…), cheapest per ml first.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: A perfume house: Arabic name, country, founding year, website, how many perfumes.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: A perfume note (e.g. vanilla, oud, bergamot) in Arabic/English/French and the best-known perfumes that contain it.

tools.name: get_market_prices
tools.description: A perfume's shop prices over time in one market or all: each offer's price intervals in the window (default the last 90 days, at most 366) and a daily summary per market — lowest price, median price per ml, in-stock share.

tools.name: get_market_trends
tools.description: One market by house or by bottle size: median price and price per ml, spread (interquartile range over the median), in-stock share, and the change since the start of the window.

tools.name: recommend_perfumes
tools.description: Perfumes for a taste — liked perfumes, notes, accords, gender — ranked from our records, each with a reason in Arabic, English or French. Give at least one perfume_id, note or accord.

tools.name: ask_perfume_question
tools.description: A perfume question in words (Arabic, English or French) answered from our records: the perfumes, notes and accords it names are looked up, and the answer cites every perfume_id.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: This API key's plan and the credits left this period.
